text_block_list.text:
While going over the upcoming race 
schedule with Tap Dance City in the 
trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, tell me. What do you want to 
accomplish through racing?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Me too. Making a name for myself and 
striking it rich. That's the kind of 
voyage I'm looking for—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
However, this nautical chart you just gave 
me is different. This isn't a voyage, it's 
just pure recklessness.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Show me a course that will make my heart 
dance. —I'm begging you."

Tap Dance City seems to have accumulated 
quite a bit of fatigue. We'll need to 
adjust her race schedule.
